frequency_question: How often do central bank principals with discretionary authority enact incremental reserve ratio tools when liquidity overhang targets are identified?
membership_rule: Members are instances where a central bank governing board formally designed and announced a targeted/incremental reserve ratio hike. Excluded are standard broad-based CRR adjustments applied as regular monetary tightening cycles.

cases.name: Central Bank of Turkey reserve option mechanism adjustments
PBOC dynamic reserve requirement ratio adjustments

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named key historical instances of targeted liquidity absorption instruments deployed by major central banks when principals signaled intent.
known_gaps: Excludes minor or opaque liquidity tweaks by smaller frontier central banks.
validity_reason: Central bank institutional frameworks and discretionary liquidity management powers evolve slowly over decades.
